name: handily-board
description: A board with two tabs: this session shows the task list that Claude and you share, and this machine shows every local session, the ones that wait for you first. /board opens it, and four model tools keep the list.

mode.title: Board mode
mode.description: off: the board opens only on /board or /board machine. toggle: as off, and /board on a shown this session tab closes the board. always: the board opens when the session starts.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: attention: while the this session tab is not shown, the status line names an agent that waits for permission. off: the board sets no status line.

band.title: Task band
band.description: on: while the this session tab is not shown, one line above the prompt shows the current task, done of total and an approved plan that waits. off: the board draws no band.
